professionalSummary: Seasoned Release Manager with 3+ years of end‑to‑end release experience on the online banking channel, managing 22 go‑live weekends, maintaining release calendars, and ensuring smooth customer delivery.
experienceHighlights: Led 22 live channel releases (2022‑2025), holding the release calendar and go‑live checklist throughout.
Executed post‑release watches with operations, initiating two rollbacks when login error rates exceeded thresholds.
Prepared each release via the Change Advisory Board, documenting readiness reviews and approvals.
Recorded residual risks and hand‑over conditions in release closure notes, including customer‑facing limitations.
Previously served as Release Coordinator for two years, running the go‑live checklist under the prior manager.
projectsAndWorkSamples: Release calendar 2024, go‑live checklist, change records for two rollbacks, and release closure notes for the last four releases, with Change Advisory Board references as verification trail.
